body.statement: The construction \(p^\dagger\) is generated by \(w^\dagger\), and the structural zeros leave exactly twenty compatible response-type columns. Its sharp projected polytope is \(\mathcal M^\dagger=\{\mu\in\mathbb R^3:0\leq\mu_0\leq3/4,\ 1/4\leq\mu_1\leq3/4,\ 1/2\leq\mu_2\leq1,\ \mu_0\leq\mu_2\}\), with vertex set \(\{(0,1/4,1/2),(0,1/4,1),(0,3/4,1/2),(0,3/4,1),(1/2,1/4,1/2),(1/2,3/4,1/2),(3/4,1/4,3/4),(3/4,1/4,1),(3/4,3/4,3/4),(3/4,3/4,1)\}\). The joint saddle has the unique solution \(q^\dagger=(0,1/4,3/4)\) and value \(3/16\), whereas the coordinatewise rectangle oracle has the unique solution \((0,0,1)\) and value \(1/4\). Thus the rectangle oracle fails at this law, changing both the deployed mixture and its worst-case regret by \(1/16\).
body.justification: A realizable exact witness demonstrates a strict policy and regret gain from respecting cross-action feasibility.
body.gap: HruzaEtAl2026CategoricalPIL cannot express randomized joint-polytope optimality, and a single inequality such as \(\mu_0\leq\mu_2\) alone would not establish the stated numbers; this theorem supplies the complete observable law, latent realization, facets, and vertices.
body.consumer: The witness is a regression test for the released multicategory code and every response-type basis enumerator used in the paper.
